title: Lessons for every feature
thisBuild: New in the menu (☰): Learn. 16 short lessons, each one a feature: Pads and banks, Hold, On the beat, Note repeat, Padiano, XY sphere, Stretch or Grain, Sustain, Bake, Make a synth, Synthipad, Steps, Roll, Loops at your tempo, Packs, Latency and notes.
A lesson rings the control it means with a pulsing yellow box and waits until you have really done the step (the app watches itself), then moves on. Back, Skip step and Stop lesson are on its card.

Lessons run on a practice mess. Your own mess is put back exactly when the lesson ends or stops, and autosave is paused while a lesson runs. If the app closes mid-lesson, your mess comes back the next time it opens.
Finished lessons get a check mark in Learn.
From build 68: Packs in Sounds, and the Vault for reviewing the RC-505 clips.
watch: Run two or three lessons start to finish. Send a note if a step does not move on after you did it, or if the yellow box points at the wrong thing.
Stop a lesson halfway and check your mess is exactly as you left it.
The Padiano lesson's first step is in the pad menu, which opens over the screen: the box can't ring menu items, so the card says what to tap.
limits: Lessons can't tell how something sounds, only that you did it.
Ending a lesson clears Undo history for your mess (the mess itself is untouched).
Song and My Desk do not have lessons yet.
